title: THIS is the PREMIUM SIDE OF CHINA!! *EVOLVE CIMA GR*

takeaways.text: Quoted at US$1,999 for frame, fork and seatpost, or US$2,199 with the 15 mm-rise gravel bar (October 2026).
Evolve claims a T800, T1100 and M40 blend at 750 g unpainted in size M, 17 W saved at 35 km/h against an unstated reference, and a 7.5% stiffer bottom bracket.
Headset bearings are plain stainless steel rather than the ceramic units on Evolve's road frame; the textured paint looked hard to clean, and the fork has no cargo mounts.
Clearance is 50 mm front and rear (printed on the fork), with a 50T maximum 1× ring; 2× is electronic-only, while 1× works with mechanical or electronic groupsets.
Size ML: frame 974 g painted with all hardware and bash guard, uncut fork 394 g, seatpost 154 g, riser bar 323 g.

disclosure: Unboxing by a US shop-owner YouTuber who links the frame; how it was obtained and any affiliate terms are not stated.
summary: Unboxing and component weigh-in of a size ML Evolve CIMA GR frameset in Sahara Nude textured paint.
